session.title: Troubleshooting 1Password UI Issues and Agent Tasks
session.summary:
## BLUF
The team is actively troubleshooting environment UI issues for 1Password and Workable while managing AI agent task queues and resolving Docker build failures.

## Decisions
- Create a CSV to overlay PR changes to avoid immediate merge conflicts.
- Proceed with starting Tiger runs for Workable.
- Investigate and fix the failing Docker container build instead of reverting PR 56677.

## Key Outcomes
- Tool coiling tasks are finalized and ready for submission.
- Cleaned up erroneous tags on Workable tasks.
- Identified specific 1Password UI bugs to assign to agents.

## Risks/Notes
- 1Password environment remains highly unstable visually (transparent forms, black fields).
- Regular grading is currently failing for specific tasks.
- Docker image builds are failing, potentially blocking QA.
